frozen_measurement.q: AVX2 dispatch admissibility at the frozen implementation surface; q=1 when AVX2 dispatch is enabled and runtime-detectable, q=0 in the upstream-supported no_avx2 intervention arm
frozen_measurement.g: actual selected SIMD backend class at runtime, binarized prospectively as AVX2 selected/admitted=1 vs non-AVX2 fallback selected=0
frozen_measurement.y: public BLAKE3 hash action returns the frozen expected digest for the same input; success/correctness=1, failure/mismatch=0

intervention.name: UPSTREAM_DROP_AVX2
intervention.baseline_arm: default dispatch with no_avx512 held constant for environmental stability
intervention.drop_arm: upstream testing feature no_avx2 with no_avx512 held constant
upstream_support: Cargo.toml describes no_avx2 as a testing feature that simulates different levels of hardware SIMD support
C dispatch source excludes AVX2 when BLAKE3_NO_AVX2 is defined

adjudication_rule: If hosted baseline selects AVX2, the no_avx2 arm selects a non-AVX2 fallback, and both produce the same frozen digest, classify X1 exact. If baseline lacks AVX2 or direct backend measurement fails, HOLD rather than reinterpret q/g/y.
